Q6097.reason: In most states today a gift to someone and the heirs of his body creates a fee simple absolute, so the grantor retained nothing to convey to the niece.

Q8324.reason: Agitated, threatening drug-seeking fits chronic dependence, whose established dopamine adaptation is downregulation of postsynaptic D2 receptors rather than synaptic depletion.
